## 3. Sensor Fusion Demo

### Source: `sensor_fusion_fast.c` (new, 19KB)
### Run: 2026-07-27T22:35Z

| Metric | Result | Target | Status |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Accuracy | 25.0% | > 90% | ❌ FAIL |
| Latency | 59 ms | < 200 µs | ❌ FAIL |
| Vision conf | 1.984 | — | — |
| Audio conf | 1.611 | — | — |

### Issues Identified
1. **Training convergence**: 0% after 50 epochs — prototypes not learning
2. **Classification**: All samples classified as class_3 (prototype collapse)
3. **Latency**: 59ms per sample (should be < 200µs)
4. **Settling time**: 30 steps × 3 chunks = 90 steps per micro (too slow)

### Fix Required
- Increase learning rate from 0.1 to 0.5
- Reduce settle steps from 30 to 10
- Add gradient clipping to prevent prototype collapse
- Implement contrastive learning for better separation
